nodes.label: Websocket tests for Voice Assistant integration.
Make sure that we can load/save data correctly.
Mock the conversation ID of chat sessions.
Mock the TTS token for URLs.
Test loading stored pipelines on start.
Test loading stored pipelines from an older version.
Test that we filter the right things.
Test wake word stream is first detected, then aborted.
Test that pipeline run equality uses unique id.
Test that text-only runs do not start debug recording.
Test using tts_audio_output with wav sets options correctly.
Test that preferred format options are given to the TTS system if supported.
Test that preferred format options are given to the TTS system if supported.
Test sentence triggers checked before non-default agent.
Test that the default agent is checked first when local intents are preferred.
Test that a conversation agent flagging continue conversation gets response.
Test STT language is used first when conversation language is '*'.
Test TTS language used after STT when conversation language is '*'.
Test pipeline language used last when conversation language is '*'.
Test that chat log events are streamed to the TTS entity.
Test that acknowledge sound is played when targets are in the same area.
Test acknowledge works when satellite and target inherit area from a parent.
Test acknowledge sound only plays for locally processed intents.
Test VAD enabled only when requires_external_vad is True.
Test that an invalid pipeline won't create a TTS ResultStream.
Test that a pipeline error before TTS will not leak a ResultStream.
